title: Cross-team engineering leadership weekly staff notes - 2026-07-27
body:
Meeting: Cross-team engineering leadership weekly staff
Date: 2026-07-27
Time: 10:00 - 11:00 PT
Location: Zoom / #serving-runtime
Attendees: Aisha Patel (owner), Michael Chen, Sofia Ramirez, David Nguyen, Priya Kapoor, Eric Thompson, Rachel Li (brief), Carlos Mendes (brief)
Absent: N/A

Agenda:
- Quick wins / highlights
- Production incidents and reliability update
- Release readiness: 2026.08.01 inference runtime patch
- Dedicated / Private deployments status and capacity planning
- Console / telemetry gaps (observability asks)
- Cross-team requests and blockers
- Action items and owners

1) Highlights / Quick wins
- KV cache improvement rollout completed to canary pool B; observed ~18% median tail latency improvement on 8k seq workloads (internal benchmark, small sample). Great ops + runtime work from Michael / David.
- Customer success flagged early positive signal from a mid-market customer using dedicated capacity with prefix caching enabled — lower token spend by ~12% in early experiments. Noted in CS notes (linked).
- New autoscaling policy experiments applied to a Dedicated tenant reduced overprovision by ~15% during off-peak hours (Priya).

2) Production incidents / reliability
- Incident SRV-987 (memory leak during long-running chat sessions) summarized: regression introduced in runtime PR #456. Root cause: delayed KV eviction path when quantized model paths activated. Hotfix deployed 2026-07-25, RCA doc in CON-1423.
  - Impact: elevated OOMs on a subset of customers in dedicated pools for ~4 hours. No customer data loss.
  - Current status: monitoring looks stable; extra telemetry added to detect recurrence.
- SRE ask: expand the crash-playbook to include a checklist for quick rollback to non-quantized kernel in the release pipeline (owner: Eric).

3) Release readiness (2026.08.01 runtime patch)
- Code freeze today EOD for release branch. Outstanding PRs: two infra fixes and a docs update.
- Testing: end-to-end smoke tests passing in canary; perf regression suite shows parity across 95th percentile latencies. Team to run a final canary over weekend (owner: Michael).
- Risk: the memory-leak hotfix touches kernel selection path — need one more perf run under long-chat synthetic workload (owner: David).

4) Dedicated / Private deployments status
- Capacity planning: bookings increased by 20% this quarter; Dedicated pool provisioning timeline tightened. Infra expects additional 4x A100-equivalent capacity by 2026-08-12 if procurement clears (Rachel).
- Private deployment (on-prem) onboarding: two pilots scheduled for August. Action: compile a deployment checklist and security questionnaire for customers (owner: Sofia).
- KMS integration: QA uncovered intermittent failures when rotating keys. Team to coordinate with security to scope a post-release patch (owner: Priya).

5) Console / telemetry gaps (observability)
- Gap: token-level cost breakdown for canary routes not yet surfaced in the console. Product asks for ETA to avoid regressing transparency for customers. Proposed short-term workaround: export a CSV from query logs (owner: Carlos; ETA: 2026-07-30).
- Tracing: distributed traces missing model-variant metadata occasionally — needs a small runtime tagging change (owner: Michael).

6) Cross-team requests / blockers
- Product: needs a short spec for model-variant fallback UX for hosted API (due 2026-08-03). Product offered to pair with eng for wording.
- Solutions engineering: asks for a durable test harness that can simulate mixed-workload (embedding + chat + reranking) across dedicated pools (owner: David). Blocker: noisy tenants in the CI environment; ops to isolate.

7) Decisions
- Proceed with 2026.08.01 patch release provided final long-chat perf run passes by end-of-day 2026-07-28. If not, postpone to 2026-08-03.
- Adopt temporary KMS rotation guardrail for Private deployments: disable automatic rotation during customer onboarding windows until KMS patch complete.

8) Action items
- Michael Chen: run final canary/perf run for release with long-chat synthetic workload; report by EOD 2026-07-28.
- David Nguyen: triage and add additional unit/integration tests covering the KV eviction path; complete by 2026-07-30.
- Eric Thompson (SRE): update crash-playbook with rollback checklist and runbook for kernel-selection regressions; complete by 2026-07-31.
- Priya Kapoor: scope KMS rotation failure fixes and coordinate with Security + QA; provide plan by 2026-08-02.
- Sofia Ramirez: prepare Private deployment onboarding checklist and security questionnaire for pilot customers; deliver draft by 2026-07-30.
- Carlos Mendes: temporary export workaround for token-level cost breakdown in console; ETA 2026-07-30.
- Rachel Li: confirm procurement timeline for Dedicated capacity and escalate any blockers by 2026-07-29.
- Product (owner TBD): deliver short UX spec for model-variant fallback by 2026-08-03.

9) Parking lot / long-range items
- Revisit autoscaling policy defaults after two more production cycles (September).
- Evaluate adding model quantization profiles to the Optimize recommendations (Q4 roadmap).

Notes / attachments:
- RCA: CON-1423 (memory leak)
- Release branch: GitHub PR #456
- Perf dashboards: internal link (request via console)
- SRE runbook template: internal drive worksheet

Next meeting: 2026-08-03, 10:00 PT

End of notes.
